title: READABLE STASH BREAK DOWN MENU
why: The break down camera review found tiny text, uneven key rows and an action menu covering stash items and pad stats. The stash now uses the menu type and spacing from the style guide. Watch: cheap parts could make bench guns and armour easy to craft; watch his stash for servo and board hoards.
now: Stash actions use 20px painted labels and 16px hints at 1080p, a five by two key grid, and placement clear of occupied stash tiles and the stat card when space allows. Rarity stays in the 3px foot bar, quantities are neutral, wanted prices use a reserved sub-row, and gear, armory and trophy shortcuts sit together with the tabs. The repeated bag value is hidden.
